gbm_population_evidence.quote: Dose escalation portion: patients with recurrent high-grade glioma, IDH wt or IDH mutated, grade 3 or grade 4 based on imaging.
Dose expansion portion: Recurrent, IDH wt, glioblastoma, WHO grade 4. Diagnosis has be made using the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the CNS.

candidate_evidence.quote: MVR-C5252 is a genetically modified next generation oncolytic herpes simplex virus 1 (oHSV1) with an active domain of human IL-12 and Fab fragment of anti-PD-1 antibody.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The subject must have received standard radiation therapy plus temozolomide and be refractory to radiation therapy plus temozolomide prior to enrollment.

role_evidence.quote: MVR-C5252 is a genetically modified next generation oncolytic herpes simplex virus 1 (oHSV1) with an active domain of human IL-12 and Fab fragment of anti-PD-1 antibody.

agents.drug_class_hint: oncolytic HSV-1 (MVR-C5252) armed with IL-12 and anti-PD-1 Fab, given intratumorally by convection-enhanced delivery
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: During viral replication, IL-12 and anti-PD-1 antibody are expressed and secreted into the tumor microenvironment, acting synergistically by increasing the T cell infiltration, converting the cold (immune suppressing) tumor to hot (immune active) tumor, and inducing anti-tumor specific immunity.

source_quote.quote: Dose expansion portion: Recurrent, IDH wt, glioblastoma, WHO grade 4. Diagnosis has be made using the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the CNS.

coder_notes: Oncolytic virus trial; no pharmacological candidate. Glioblastoma named in inclusion criteria for the dose-expansion cohort; escalation allows grade 3/4 IDH-wt or IDH-mutant HGG. Gadolinium is co-infused in Stage 1 to track CED distribution but is not a registered intervention and not given to every patient, so not listed. IDH-wildtype requirement applies to the expansion cohort only (single registered arm), coded enrichment; it defines GBM and is not candidate-matched.
